items.lede: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia are suing several of Elon Musk’s companies, alleging they implemented weak safeguards against sexualized imagery of real people, including children.
items.title: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok Deepfakes

items.lede: Oregon and Virginia's attorneys general said the company broke state consumer protection laws.
items.title: Two states sue SpaceX over sexually explicit Grok deepfakes
